correctness.rationale: A house that is top-ranked by at least two of three strict agents cannot belong to an envy-free assignment, so it may be deleted without changing feasibility. Conditional on every deletion history, refreshed favorites are iid uniform among surviving houses; failure at r surviving houses is (3r-2)/r^2. This yields the product tail, difference mass, gamma normalization, finite mean and superfactorial decay. Independently enumerated all 3-agent strict-ranking triples after fixing one agent for m=3..6; failures are 7/9,35/72,91/360,91/810 and agree exactly.
